name: spectral-smear
description:
Smear: every bin rings on after its sound has gone, like a reverb with no
echoes in it.

The magnitude of each bin is followed with a fast rise and a slow fall.
While a bin is being fed it keeps the phase of the input; once it is only
ringing out, its phase keeps turning at the rate it last had.

spectrograms.label: Chirp (0 Hz → Nyquist over 5 s → decay)
